captions.detailed: A clamp-on welding vise with a dark grey or black body. It features a parallel C-clamp base at the bottom for securing to a workbench, complete with a metallic silver screw and thin handle pin. The upper assembly includes a fixed rear jaw and a front jaw that slides prismatically along two parallel, silver-colored guide rods capped with hexagonal ends.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a clamp-on welding vise in CadQuery. It should feature a dark-colored C-clamp base with a silver tightening screw at the bottom, a fixed jaw, and a front jaw that slides along two parallel silver guide rods with hexagonal end caps.
captions.factory: Construct the base using box primitives combined to form the C-clamp frame and fixed jaw. Create the sliding jaw as a separate block, and define two parallel cylindrical guide rods with hexagonal caps at their ends. Model the lower clamping screw and its thin handle pin using cylinders, and establish prismatic joint limits for the sliding jaw and revolute limits for the screw.
